title: Hiking With Babies and Toddlers Guide and Kids Scavenger Hunt Bundle, Family Hiking Printable, Junior Hiker Journal, New Parent Gift PDF
description:
Our two family hiking printables together, for parents who want to keep hiking as the kids grow: the Hiking With Babies and Toddlers guide for the carrier and toddler years, and the Kids Trail Explorer Pack for ages 4 to 10. A simple gift for new parents who love the outdoors. $10.99 instead of $12.98 bought separately.

WHAT'S INSIDE
- Hiking With Babies and Toddlers, Parent's Guide and Checklists (24 pages): picking a first family trail, carriers by age with a fit check, the parent pack, a printable packing checklist, dressing a little one for heat and cold, feeding, diapers and naps on the trail, bugs and ticks, turnaround rules, first aid additions, a family hike planner and a first hikes log
- Kids Trail Explorer Pack, Scavenger Hunts and Junior Hiker Journal (24 pages): four seasonal scavenger hunts in three levels, trail bingo, a five senses walk, a trail sign spotter, trail rules in kid words, Leave No Trace for kids, junior hiker journal pages, a hike count tracker and a Junior Trail Explorer certificate

WHAT YOU GET
- Both printables in US Letter, A4 and a mobile edition, one ZIP per format
- Printer-friendly low-ink versions of both
- Instant download. These are digital files; nothing is shipped.
- Bonus: our free one-page Ultimate Hiking Checklist

GOOD TO KNOW
The same two printables sold on their own, no extra content. Not medical advice: ask your pediatrician about sun protection, insect repellent and cold weather for little ones. Kids should always hike with a grown-up. For personal and family use.

Made by HikeSupply Co., a small shop for weekend hikers. More printable hiking guides in our Etsy shop.
